subject: ISO bridge & FedRAMP snapshot — evidence pull plan and window
messages:
From: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
To: john.bradley@rainfallcyber.com, security@broadleafhealth.com
Cc: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ISO bridge & FedRAMP snapshot — evidence pull plan and window

Hi John / Broadleaf security team,

Thanks for lining up the intake call next week. To keep the pre-audit work efficient, can we lock the evidence snapshot window we discussed? Proposed plan below: 

- Snapshot window: 2027-07-22 00:00 UTC -> 2027-07-24 23:59 UTC (48–72h capture depending on logs)
- Deliverables we can produce from the snapshot:
  * Host and container inventory export (CSV)
  * S3 access logs (JSONL sample + full archive link)
  * ACL and IAM role mapping (PDF manifest + crosswalk)
  * Relevant audit trail extracts for control families: access logging, change management, key rotation

Action items for our team: Priya — can you confirm control owners and whether we should include service account token scans in the snapshot? Neha — can ops produce an s3 logs sample and the manifest by EOD 21-Jul?

Attachments: snapshot-manifest.csv (template we will fill), example ACL extract placeholder.

If the snapshot window works for you we'll lock it and provide a secure transfer link and a time for the intake handoff.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: snapshot-manifest.csv (format guide), access-control-list.pdf (example)

From: john.bradley@rainfallcyber.com
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: security@broadleafhealth.com, priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: ISO bridge & FedRAMP snapshot — evidence pull plan and window

Rachel — thanks, that window looks reasonable. A few clarifying questions before we lock: 

1) Retention/traceback: For change-management trails, do you keep a 90-day immutable log for config changes? If so, we only need the snapshot excerpt; if not, we may need a backfill request.
2) Preferred transfer: S3 presigned URL or encrypted share to our SFTP? Broadleaf prefers S3 presigned links to their intake pipeline.
3) Token scans: Do you want us to run a best-effort token exposure scan during the snapshot, or do you prefer Redwood run an internal scan and share results?

We can take the snapshot as proposed and schedule a 30-min intake on 2027-07-22 14:00 UTC to review the manifest and handoff key files.

John Bradley
Senior Auditor — Rainfall Cyber Assessments
john.bradley@rainfallcyber.com

Quick update from the control-owner side: 

- Control owners: Identity & Access (Neha), Infra Change Mgmt (Priya), Keys/Secrets (SRE lead, cc'ed separately if needed).
- Token scans: We will run an internal token exposure scan and share redacted results; prefer external team not run intrusive scans on our CI/CD systems during the snapshot window.
- Retention: We maintain 180-day append-only logs for config-change events in the change management system (so backfill not required).

I can prepare the control-owner manifest and a mapping doc that ties each requested artifact to the ISO/FedRAMP control IDs — I will attach the initial mapping to the Drive folder and upload the snapshot-manifest.csv filled with our values by end of day 21-Jul.

Intake call: 2027-07-22 14:00 UTC works for me. John, can you confirm the S3 presigned link is acceptable?

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan

Redwood Inference
